title: Comparative aptamer profiling reveals cell surface remodeling and the emergence of a noncanonical cell surface protein under oncogenic signaling
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00110B, Paper

Jungo Kakuta, Kenji Ohba, Hideaki Ogasawara, Kyohei Okahara, Kazumi Emoto, Hiroaki Sako, Miho Sekai, Yasuyuki Fujita, Toshio Imai, Yogo Sakakibara
Comparative aptamer profiling was established to examine cell surface molecular states. This approach revealed bidirectional alterations and unexpected surface localization of a mitochondrial protein under oncogenic signaling.
